chunks: And with his chain of narration, he said: Ali (peace be upon him) said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) prayed for me and said: O God, guide his heart, expand his breast, strengthen his tongue, and protect him from heat and cold.
ai.seo_question: What was the specific dua the Prophet Muhammad made for Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the Prophet’s (S) intercession for Ali (a.s.), emphasizing spiritual guidance (hidaya), intellectual clarity (sadr), and eloquent articulation (lisān) essential for his role as the Imam. The request for protection from 'heat and cold' is interpreted by Shia scholars as a metaphor for enduring the trials of leadership and the rigors of conveying the divine message. It underscores the holistic nature of Imamate, combining inner spiritual fortitude with outer communicative power.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-240 According to the same documentation, Ali (a.s.) said, “
The Prophet (S) prayed for me and said, O my God! expand his breast, strengthen his tongue, and protect him from heat and cold.”
